integrity: Proof gives a deterministic comparison and uniform renewal concentration; an independent finite checker corroborates finite identities but cannot certify infinite convergence.
scientific_limitations: Only the zero- and one-bridge components are identified at the critical scale; the complete critical limiting distribution, fluctuations, finite-size stochastic monotonicity and mixing-time bounds remain unproved. The Kemeny-Wiener identity is credited to previous work.
title: A sharp transport crossover in two-lag Bernoulli recursive trees
